points.point: Q1a - ANCHOR-Lite and A1 as national slots 7-8
points.ruling: Allowed, only under the rulings of F3, F5, F6, F7 and DS-07 together; if the lead does not adopt any one of them, ANCHOR-Lite and A1 run on P2 only. No new national label type either way.
points.reason: Both reviewers allow it under terms. Test-N is unseen and the look is single, but the design followed the national validation picture and the cap of 8 is in no stamped file, so the terms carry the protection. The slots must train on labels built under the label rule.

points.point: Q1b - added comparators as applicable national baselines
points.ruling: Yes, and mandatory for whichever configuration is selected: S6-S9, S10 (TabPFN), S11 (GBM-stacked), P1, P2a/b and P3a/b join the frozen list, each under the every-seed rule, fitted on the selected candidate's own training rows and label version.
points.reason: It can only remove a label. Without S6, S10 and S11 a candidate with scene, location and season inputs could pass H1 against baselines that lack them.

points.point: Q2 - recovered labels on national test-role chips
points.ruling: Not built, not loaded, not reported. The descriptive table is rejected.
points.reason: Both reviewers agree. The lead ruled that no target-scoped label is added on the national track after validation was seen; a table would create new label values on protected rows.

points.point: Q3 - reduced context set
points.ruling: Accepted as written (50 scene statistics, lat, lon, DOY; no site class, no HydroLAKES morphometry), identical for candidate, anchor and every parity comparator; nothing is added later; recorded as a plan deviation; claims say 'GBM with the same information', never 'strongest tabular model'.
points.reason: Parity holds because the candidate lacks those inputs too. The plan's wider C2 feature set is not tested, so the wording must not imply it was.

points.point: Q4 - TabPFN not run
points.ruling: Not acceptable. S10 runs as specified in the F2 ruling.
points.reason: The premise is false: tabpfn 2.2.1, its regressor checkpoint and a project loader are on disk; SYNTHESIS X6 and the lead's afternoon ruling make it mandatory.

points.point: Q5 - out-of-fold anchor in training, refit anchor at evaluation; XGBoost AFT
points.ruling: Accepted. Before any validation number, unit tests must show: no fold model is fitted on a row of the water body it predicts; the refit table holds no evaluation-role chip or water body; national-2b additions and train_p2 take water-body ids from one grouping; the evaluation anchor and S6 are one hash-pinned artefact. Anchors on time-held-out rows of training water bodies are reported as a separate stratum. AFT accepted with the fixed parameters and a registered target list.
points.reason: No label leak found: folds are whole water bodies by salted hash (l.189-190), evaluation rows are never training rows, and baselines.GBM_PARAMS has no early stopping or eval_set (baselines.py l.14-15, l.72-74), so no validation row enters a fit. Train anchors are out-of-fold and evaluation anchors are refit; that shift works against the candidate, not for it.

points.point: Q6 - P2 constants
points.ruling: All stand exactly as locked: 40/20/40, sonde mean else median, 50 m2 within 30 m, floor 100 chips and 40 water bodies, train_p2 years <= 2021. When the index is rebuilt for the label rule, only the label filter changes.
points.reason: The lock predates the matched counts; the counts are now known and val_p2 values have been read, so any change would be a choice made after counts.

points.point: Q7 - CyFi-style and DenseNet differences
points.ruling: Accepted, always worded 'CyFi-style' and 'HydroVision-style re-implementation on NAIP' with the differences listed in every table; P2b and P3b are required; national learning-rate tie keeps 1e-4; on P2 both learning rates are run and reported.
points.reason: The differences are forced by NAIP or favour the comparator. A win over them is not a win over the published systems. val_p2 is too concentrated (91 of 153 chips in one water body) to tune a comparator on.

points.point: Q8 - download of DenseNet121 weights
